Reasoning-effort picker, shown only for reasoning-capable models. The empty value means "no extended thinking". Strict: only the listed options commit.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/chat/ModelSelector.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { EffortSelector } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/chat";
```
